fee_details:
- Joining Fee: Rs.2000 (May be waived)
- Annual Fee: Rs.3000 (for subsequently)
- Supplementary card joining fee: NIL
- Supplementary card annual fee: NIL
- Finance charges on cash and retail purchases: 3.6% per month (43.2% per annum)
- Cash withdrawal fees: 2.5% of the amount of cash withdrawn (Minimum of Rs.250)
- Fee for payment in cash: Rs.100
- Late payment fees/overdue charges:
    - NIL case the outstanding amount is up to Rs.300
    - Rs.500 in case the outstanding amount is between Rs.501 to Rs.5000
    - Rs.2500 in case the outstanding amount is between Rs.5001 to Rs.10,000
    - Rs.5000 in case the outstanding amount is more than Rs.10,000
- Penalty for over limit: 3% of the over limit amount to a minimum of Rs.500
- Fee for retrieval of change slip/copy request: Waived
- Fee for substitution cheque: Waived
- Dishonour of check/hear auto return/reverse bank account on our hands: Rs.300
- Charges on cancellation or purchase of railway tickets: As suggested by Indian Railways/IRCTC
- Surcharge on fuel transaction: 1% of the amount transacted (for transactions between Rs.5,000 and Rs.40,000)
- Fee on foreign currency transaction: 3.5% on the transaction value
- Mobile alerts for transactions: Free of cost
- Charges for hot listing: Free of cost
- Charges on balance enquiry: Free of cost

how_tos.How to apply for Axis Bank Select Credit:
Individuals interested in procuring an Axis Bank Select credit card can apply for this card online as well as offline. Here’s how they can do it:
Offline method:
Applicants can visit their nearest branch of Axis Bank and ask for an application form. After filling up the form, they can attach the necessary documents and identity proofs and submit the form at the branch.
Applicants can call the Axis Bank phone banking number: 1860-419-5555 or +91 808-580-5555 (STD/ISD) with their queries and avail and Axis Bank credit card customer care exclusively to put them in touch with the credit card department.
Online method:
Applicants can go to the official website of Axis Credit Cards: www.axisbank.com and click on Axis Bank Select Credit Card from the credit cards listed on the site. They can go on the apply section and follow the instructions.

faqs.How do I get the PIN of my Axis Bank Sel: The PIN of the Axis Bank Select credit card will be sent to you via secure mail.
faqs.In case of theft or loss, how do I block: You can contact us or block your Axis Bank Select Credit Card by SMS to 567676 from the mobile number that is registered with the bank.
faqs.How can I return my purchases made using: You can contact the bank to return your purchase made on Axis Bank Select Credit Card (MMS). However, the transaction shouldn’t be more than Rs.2500.
faqs.How can I activate my new Axis Bank Sele: You can activate your card by sending an SMS. space followed by the last four digits of the card 567676 from your registered Indian mobile number and have a proper response to the activation of the credit card.
faqs.Will I have to make a separate request t: You will receive the Axis Bank credit card; you just need a statement to get to you via email.
faqs.How do I reach the customer care desk of: You can reach the Axis Bank customer care desk at 1860-419-5555 or +91 808-580-5555.
faqs.Do I get a liability cover for my own lo: Yes, you get a liability value of cover for a loan of Rs.10,00,000.
faqs.Will I get a statement of the credit car: You can opt for a three-time statement facility using which they can access Axis Bank cards and statement anywhere and anytime.
